description: Source code for the sqlstore implementation of channel bookmark management in Mattermost, including CRUD operations, sorting, and validation.

classes.name: SqlChannelBookmarkStore
classes.description: Implements the store for channel bookmarks, providing methods for CRUD operations, sorting, and validation.

methods.name: ErrorIfBookmarkFileInfoAlreadyAttached
methods.description: Checks if a file info is already attached to a channel bookmark to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a channel bookmark with associated file info by ID, optionally including deleted.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Creates a new channel bookmark, with optional sort order increase, validating and attaching file info.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing channel bookmark's details.

methods.name: UpdateSortOrder
methods.description: Reorders bookmarks within a channel based on a new index.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Marks a bookmark (and optionally its file info) as deleted.

methods.name: GetBookmarksForChannelSince
methods.description: Retrieves bookmarks for a channel since a specified timestamp, with ordering and limit.
